lede.zh: 给一台仓库机器人装上眼睛：从一格格的数开始，自己搭出去噪、找边、读单据的机器，再一路走到会学习、会测距、会画图的视觉系统。
lede.en: Give a warehouse robot its eyes: start from a grid of numbers, build the machines that denoise, find edges and read documents, and go on to a vision system that learns, measures distance and draws.

question.zh: 怎样用邻居把一张夜里拍的单据看清楚？
question.en: How do neighbours make a night photo of a document readable?

t.zh: 机器人拍下的单据上满是一道道竖纹：相机传感器三列一组轮流读数，组里三列的灵敏度各不相同。现在手上只有平移、四则运算和常数，先把竖纹压下去。<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The robot’s photos of documents are full of vertical streaks: the camera’s sensor reads its columns in groups of three, and the three differ in sensitivity. All you have are shifting, arithmetic and constants; flatten the streaks first. <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 每格和它的左右邻居平均，三列一组的偏差加起来正好抵消。这就是<wiki-ref to="neighbourhood-average"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Averaging each cell with its left and right neighbours takes in one of each of the three columns, and their errors cancel. This is a <wiki-ref to="neighbourhood-average"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 每格和它前后两格平均。方向可以选横或竖。
desc.en: Each cell averaged with the two beside it, across or down.

brief.zh: 让输出和目标一样：竖纹压平，纸和字还在。
brief.en: Match the target: streaks flattened, paper and text still there.

hint.zh: 一格自己的读数里混着它那一列的偏差。左右两格的偏差和它不一样。
hint.en: A cell’s reading carries its column’s error. The cells beside it carry different errors.

hint.zh: 平移把整张图挪一格：挪完以后，每格上放的是它旁边那一格的读数。
hint.en: Shifting moves the whole picture one cell: afterwards each cell holds its neighbour’s reading.

naiveWhy.zh: 只和一边的邻居平均，整张图往那一边偏了半格：台阶的两侧不对称。
naiveWhy.en: Averaging with one neighbour only shifts the picture half a cell that way: each step comes out lopsided.

t.zh: 纸放斜了，它的边在横向、竖向两张图里各只出现一半。把两张合成一张。
t.en: With the paper askew, its edge shows only half in each of the two change maps. Combine them into one.

after.zh: 横、竖两个变化合成一支箭头，叫<wiki-ref to="gradient"></wiki-ref>：长短是边有多陡，方向是变亮最快的方向，和边垂直。
after.en: The two changes together make one arrow, the <wiki-ref to="gradient"></wiki-ref>: its length says how steep the edge is, its direction is where brightness grows fastest, across the edge.

brief.zh: 输出边的强弱和朝向（朝向以周为单位，往右为 0，往下为 1/4）。
brief.en: Output each edge’s strength and direction (direction in turns: 0 rightwards, 1/4 downwards).

t.zh: 把这一章的零件装起来：夜里拍的单据，画出它的边。
t.en: Put the chapter’s parts together: from a night photo of a document, draw its edges.

after.zh: 降噪、求梯度、按强弱取舍，得到的是一张<wiki-ref to="edge-map"></wiki-ref>：机器眼里，纸从这里开始。
after.en: Denoise, take the gradient, keep what is strong enough: an <wiki-ref to="edge-map"></wiki-ref>. To the machine, the paper starts here.

brief.zh: 先像相机那样降噪，再在边的强弱超过「门槛」的格子标 1，其余标 0。
brief.en: Denoise as the camera does, then mark 1 where the edge strength exceeds “threshold”, 0 elsewhere.

naiveWhy.zh: 没有先降噪：字和噪点也越过了门槛。
naiveWhy.en: No denoising first: text and noise cross the threshold too.

t.zh: 夜里拍的单据，噪点不只沿横向乱跳，上下也在跳。三点平均只管左右。
t.en: Documents photographed at night are noisy across and down alike. The three-point average only looks left and right.

after.zh: 先横着平均、再竖着平均，每格就和周围九格平均了：两次一维的平均拼成一次二维的，这叫<wiki-ref to="separable"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Averaging across, then down, averages each cell with the nine around it: two one-dimensional passes make one two-dimensional average. This is <wiki-ref to="separable"></wiki-ref> filtering.

brief.zh: 让输出和目标一样：上下左右的噪点都压平。
brief.en: Match the target: noise flattened across and down.

hint.zh: 三点平均上有方向可以选。
hint.en: The three-point average has a direction to choose.

naiveWhy.zh: 只横着平均，横着的条纹一点没变。
naiveWhy.en: Averaging only across leaves horizontal stripes untouched.

t.zh: 相机自带的降噪比你的干净，厂家却没说它怎么给邻居分配分量。给它喂几张自己画的图，看它吐出什么。
t.en: The camera’s built-in denoising is cleaner than yours, and the maker never said how it weighs the neighbours. Feed it pictures you draw and watch what comes out.

after.zh: 一个亮点进去，出来的就是它给每个邻居的分量，叫<wiki-ref to="impulse-response"></wiki-ref>。这台降噪中间最重，越往外越轻。
after.en: One bright dot in, and out comes the share it gives each neighbour: its <wiki-ref to="impulse-response"></wiki-ref>. This denoiser weighs the centre most and less further out.

brief.zh: 画一张能分清三种说法的图，再选输出支持的那一种。
brief.en: Draw a picture that tells the three accounts apart, then pick the one the output supports.

hint.zh: 一整片同样亮的图，三种降噪都不会改变它。
hint.en: A picture of one brightness all over is left unchanged by all three.

hint.zh: 想看清它对每个邻居做了什么，就让只有一格是亮的。
hint.en: To see what it does with each neighbour, light just one cell.

title.zh: 它怎么给邻居分配分量？
title.en: How does it share among the neighbours?

t.zh: 相机的降噪中间重、四周轻；你的三点平均对三格一视同仁。
t.en: The camera’s denoising weighs the centre more; your three-point average treats all three the same.

after.zh: 平均只是三个分量都等于三分之一的特例；每格乘上各自的分量再相加，叫<wiki-ref to="weighted-sum"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: An average is the case where all three shares are a third; multiplying each cell by its own share and adding is a <wiki-ref to="weighted-sum"></wiki-ref>.

desc.zh: 每格和它前后两格按三个权重相加。方向可以选横或竖。
desc.en: Each cell and the two beside it added by three weights, across or down.

brief.zh: 让三点平均按「权重」给左、中、右三格各自的分量。
brief.en: Let the three-point average give the left, centre and right cells the shares in “weights”.

hint.zh: 权重是一行三个数：前、中、后。先把它拆开。
hint.en: The weights are a row of three: first, centre, last. Take it apart first.

naiveWhy.zh: 三格还是一样重：权重没有用上。
naiveWhy.en: The three cells still weigh the same: the weights go unused.

t.zh: 有了三点加权，先复现相机的降噪。相机还自带锐化，那一款就没这么好对付了。
t.en: With the three-point weighting, reproduce the camera’s denoising first. The camera also sharpens, and that one is harder.

after.zh: 一张 3×3 的权重表叫<wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>；按它给每格周围九格加权求和的机器，就是<wiki-ref to="filter"></wiki-ref>。模糊、锐化、找边，只是换一张核。
after.en: A 3×3 table of weights is a <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>; the machine that gives every cell the weighted sum of its nine by it is a <wiki-ref to="filter"></wiki-ref>. Blurring, sharpening and finding edges are just different kernels.

desc.zh: 按 3×3 的核给每格周围九格加权求和。核的左上角乘左上方的邻居。
desc.en: Each cell the sum of its nine neighbours weighted by a 3×3 kernel; the kernel’s top left weighs the neighbour up and to the left.

after.zh: 中间重的 3×3 降噪，正好是横着、竖着各做一次 [1 2 1]/4：它是<wiki-ref to="separable"></wiki-ref>的。
after.en: The centre-heavy 3×3 denoising is [1 2 1]/4 across, then down: it is <wiki-ref to="separable"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 用三点加权复现相机的降噪：中间重，越往外越轻。
brief.en: Reproduce the camera’s denoising with the three-point weighting: centre heaviest, lighter outwards.

hint.zh: 回想相机对一个亮点的输出：它的每一行、每一列各是什么比例？
hint.en: Recall the camera’s output for one bright dot: in what proportions is each row, each column?

naiveWhy.zh: 只横着做了一次：上下的邻居没有分到分量。
naiveWhy.en: Only across: the neighbours above and below get no share.

t.zh: 锐化的权重 [0 −1 0; −1 5 −1; 0 −1 0] 拆不成先横后竖两次。得有一台能装下任意 3×3 权重的机器。
t.en: Sharpening’s weights [0 −1 0; −1 5 −1; 0 −1 0] cannot be split into an across pass and a down pass. You need a machine that takes any 3×3 weights.

brief.zh: 造一台按输入的 3×3 权重给每格周围九格加权求和的机器：上面一行权重管上面一行邻居。
brief.en: Build a machine that gives each cell the sum of its nine neighbours weighted by the 3×3 weights it is given: the top row of weights weighs the row above.

hint.zh: 核的每一行，正好是一组三点加权的权重。
hint.en: Each row of the kernel is exactly one set of three-point weights.

hint.zh: 要让一行三点加权读到上面一行的邻居，先把整张图往下挪一格。
hint.en: To make a three-point weighting read the row above, first move the whole picture down a cell.

naiveWhy.zh: 先横后竖只能做出能拆成两次的核：锐化的四角是 0、边上是 −1，拆不开。
naiveWhy.en: Across then down only makes kernels that split in two: sharpening has 0 in its corners and −1 on its sides, which does not split.

t.zh: 修图软件有几款滤镜，只给了处理前后的照片。滤波器已经接好，填出每款滤镜的核。
t.en: A photo app has a few filters, and all it shows is before and after. The filter is wired; fill in each one’s kernel.

after.zh: 亮点经过滤波器，出来的是核转了 180°：滤波器按<wiki-ref to="correlation"></wiki-ref>算，照抄冲激响应就成了<wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref>的核。
after.en: A bright dot through the filter comes out as the kernel turned 180°: the filter computes <wiki-ref to="correlation"></wiki-ref>, and copying its impulse response gives the <wiki-ref to="convolution"></wiki-ref> kernel instead.

naiveWhy.zh: 照抄了亮点的输出：滤波器输出的冲激响应是核转了 180°，效果因此上下左右都颠倒了。
naiveWhy.en: This copies the bright dot’s output: the filter’s impulse response is the kernel turned 180°, so the effect comes out upside down and mirrored.

t.zh: 纸边是亮度的一道台阶。降噪把台阶抹平，得换一种权重把它找出来。
t.en: A paper edge is a step in brightness. Denoising smooths the step away; different weights are needed to find it.

after.zh: 边缘处相邻两格差得多。右边减左边、下面减上面，正负说出了变亮还是变暗的方向，这叫<wiki-ref to="derivative"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Neighbouring cells differ most at an edge. Right minus left, below minus above: the sign tells whether it brightens or darkens. This is a <wiki-ref to="derivative"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 输出两张图：横向的变化、竖向的变化。往右（往下）变亮为正。
brief.en: Output two pictures: the change across and the change down. Brightening rightwards (downwards) is positive.

hint.zh: 整片同样亮的地方，两张图都应当是 0。三个权重加起来是多少？
hint.en: Where it is evenly bright, both should be 0. What do the three weights add up to?

t.zh: 一块别人搭的去噪电路，输出四周一圈发黑。图的边上，滤波器要读的邻居有一些在图外。
t.en: Someone else’s denoising circuit leaves a dark band round the edge of every output. At the edge, some of the neighbours the filter reads lie outside the picture.

after.zh: 图外没有观测，滤波器只能假设那里是什么：补 0、延续边缘、循环、镜像，各是一种<wiki-ref to="border"></wiki-ref>。对不对，看图外实际是什么。
after.en: Nothing was observed outside the picture, so the filter can only assume what is there: zero, the edge continued, wrapped around, or mirrored, each a <wiki-ref to="border"></wiki-ref>. Which is right depends on what really lies outside.

brief.zh: 单据四周是同样的纸。去掉黑框。
brief.en: The document is surrounded by more of the same paper. Remove the dark band.

naiveWhy.zh: 图外取 0，等于假设纸外面是黑的。
naiveWhy.en: Reading zero outside assumes the paper is black beyond the edge.

brief.zh: 地砖的花纹一块块重复，照片正好拍下一整块。让边上和中间一样。
brief.en: The floor tiles repeat block after block, and the photo holds exactly one block. Make the edge match the middle.

naiveWhy.zh: 花纹是重复的：图外接着的是另一边。
naiveWhy.en: The pattern repeats: beyond one edge comes the other side.

t.zh: 把找边的电路放到夜里拍的单据上：真边还在，满屏都是一对对正负的假边。
t.en: Run the edge finder on a night photo: the real edges are there, but so are pairs of false ones everywhere.

after.zh: 相减把每个噪点都放大成一对假边。先沿着边的方向用 [1 2 1] 平滑，再垂直于边相减，噪声就压下去了，这就是 <wiki-ref to="sobel"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Subtracting turns every speck of noise into a pair of false edges. Smoothing along the edge with [1 2 1] before subtracting across it keeps the noise down: the <wiki-ref to="sobel"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 让两张变化图只剩真边，和目标一样。
brief.en: Leave only the real edges in both change maps, matching the target.

hint.zh: 找横向变化时，上下两行的邻居说的是同一道竖边。
hint.en: When finding the change across, the rows above and below see the same upright edge.

hint.zh: 目标里，正中那一行比上下两行重一倍。
hint.en: In the target, the middle row counts twice as much as the rows above and below.

naiveWhy.zh: 没有先平滑：每个噪点都成了一对假边。
naiveWhy.en: No smoothing first: each speck of noise became a pair of false edges.

body.zh: 一张数字照片是一格格的数，每一格叫一个像素：灰度图一格一个数，越大越亮；彩色图一格三个数（红、绿、蓝）。坐标从左上角 (0, 0) 起，x 向右、y 向下。COMP90086 第 2 讲。
body.en: A digital photo is a grid of numbers; each cell is a pixel. A grey image has one number a cell, larger being brighter; a colour image three (red, green, blue). Coordinates start at (0, 0) in the top left, x to the right and y downwards. COMP90086 lecture 2.

body.zh: 每格换成它和周围几格的平均。各格独立的噪声互相抵消一部分，成片的东西留下；代价是细节也被抹平一些。第 3 讲。
body.en: Each cell replaced by the average of itself and the cells around it. Noise that differs from cell to cell partly cancels while larger shapes stay; the price is that fine detail is smoothed too. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 一个二维的权重表能写成「一列权重 × 一行权重」时，它就是可分离的：先横着用一行权重做一次，再竖着用一列权重做一次，结果相同、乘法更少。方块平均和高斯都可分离；锐化、拉普拉斯不行。第 3 讲。
body.en: A two-dimensional table of weights is separable when it is a column of weights times a row of weights: one pass across with the row and one down with the column give the same result with fewer multiplications. The box average and the Gaussian are separable; sharpening and the Laplacian are not. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 只有一格是 1、其余都是 0 的输入叫冲激；一台加权求和的滤波器对它的输出叫冲激响应，它摆出了滤波器给每个邻居的分量（按互相关计算时上下左右颠倒）。第 3 讲。
body.en: An input that is 1 in one cell and 0 elsewhere is an impulse; a weighted-sum filter’s output for it is its impulse response, which lays out the share it gives each neighbour (turned 180° when the filter computes correlation). Lecture 3.

body.zh: 每个量乘上自己的权重再相加。平均是所有权重相等、加起来为 1 的加权和；权重可以是负数，这时那一项是减去的。第 3 讲。
body.en: Each quantity times its own weight, all added. An average is a weighted sum whose weights are equal and add up to 1; a weight can be negative, which subtracts its term. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 滤波器用的权重表，常见的是 3×3 或 5×5。中心那格对应当前像素，其余对应它的邻居。第 3 讲。
body.en: The table of weights a filter uses, commonly 3×3 or 5×5. The centre cell stands for the current pixel and the rest for its neighbours. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 把核的中心对准每一个像素，用核给它周围的像素加权求和，得到这一格的新值。同一张核用在整张图上，所以叫线性、平移不变的滤波。第 3 讲。
body.en: Centre the kernel on every pixel and take the sum of the pixels around it weighted by the kernel: that is the cell’s new value. One kernel is used over the whole image, which makes the filtering linear and shift-invariant. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 核的左上角乘左上方的邻居：按核写下的样子直接对上去求加权和。冲激经过互相关，出来的是核转了 180°。第 3 讲。
body.en: The kernel’s top left weighs the neighbour up and to the left: the weighted sum with the kernel laid on as written. An impulse through correlation comes out as the kernel turned 180°. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 先把核转 180°，再做互相关。冲激经过卷积，出来的就是核本身。对称的核两者一样；不对称的核（浮雕）效果颠倒。第 3 讲。
body.en: Turn the kernel 180°, then correlate. An impulse through convolution comes out as the kernel itself. A symmetric kernel gives the same either way; an asymmetric one (emboss) comes out reversed. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 图的边上，核要读的邻居有一些在图外。图外没有观测，只能假设：补 0、延续边缘、循环、镜像。不同假设只改变边上一圈的结果；哪个对，取决于图外实际是什么。第 3 讲。
body.en: At the image’s edge some neighbours the kernel reads lie outside it. Nothing was observed there, so it must be assumed: zero, the edge continued, wrapped around, or mirrored. The assumption changes only the band along the edge; which is right depends on what really lies outside. Lecture 3.

body.zh: 相邻两格的差，图像版的导数：权重 [−1 0 1] 给出右边减左边。平坦处为 0，变亮为正、变暗为负。第 5 讲。
body.en: The difference between neighbouring cells, the image’s derivative: weights [−1 0 1] give right minus left. It is 0 where flat, positive where brightening, negative where darkening. Lecture 5.

body.zh: 沿边的方向用 [1 2 1] 平滑、垂直于边用 [−1 0 1] 求差，合成一张 3×3 的核。平滑压住噪声，差分找出变化。第 5 讲。
body.en: Smoothing along the edge with [1 2 1] and differencing across it with [−1 0 1], combined in one 3×3 kernel. The smoothing keeps noise down; the difference finds the change. Lecture 5.

body.zh: 横、竖两个方向的变化合成的箭头。长度是亮度变化有多陡，方向是变亮最快的方向，和边垂直。第 5 讲。
body.en: The arrow made of the change across and the change down. Its length is how steeply brightness changes; its direction is where it brightens fastest, across the edge. Lecture 5.

body.zh: 梯度大小超过门槛的像素标 1、其余标 0 的图。门槛低了噪声和纹理也算边，高了弱的边会断。第 5 讲。
body.en: An image marking 1 where the gradient’s length exceeds a threshold and 0 elsewhere. Too low a threshold lets noise and texture count as edges; too high breaks weak ones. Lecture 5.

about.zh: 图外读最近的边上那一格。
about.en: Outside reads the nearest edge cell.
Outside continues from the opposite side.

about.zh: 图外照着边缘镜像，边上那一格也算一次。
about.en: Outside mirrors the edge, the edge cell included.

desc.zh: 把整张图沿横向或竖向挪一格：挪完以后，每格上放的是它旁边那一格的读数。
desc.en: Move the whole picture one cell across or down: afterwards each cell holds its neighbour’s reading.

shift.compute: match $axis { x: match $by { forward: shift(image, vector2(-1, 0), outside=$outside), backward: shift(image, vector2(1, 0), outside=$outside) }, y: match $by { forward: shift(image, vector2(0, -1), outside=$outside), backward: shift(image, vector2(0, 1), outside=$outside) } }

desc.zh: a 和 b 逐格运算；一个数和一张图运算时，这个数用在每一格上。
desc.en: a and b cell by cell; a number with an image applies to every cell.

arithmetic.compute: match $op { add: add(a, b), sub: sub(a, b), mul: mul(a, b), div: div(a, b) }

desc.zh: 一个固定的值：一个数、一行三个权重，或一张 3×3 的核。
desc.en: A fixed value: a number, a row of three weights, or a 3×3 kernel.

const.compute: match $kind { scalar: $value, row3: weightVector($first, $centre, $last), kernel3: kernel3($k1, $k2, $k3, $k4, $k5, $k6, $k7, $k8, $k9) }

desc.zh: 一行三个权重拆成前、中、后三个数。
desc.en: A row of three weights taken apart into first, centre and last.

desc.zh: 3×3 的核拆成上、中、下三行，每行三个权重。
desc.en: A 3×3 kernel taken apart into its top, middle and bottom rows of three weights.

desc.zh: 把 x、y 当成箭头的横竖两个分量，给出箭头的长度 √(x² + y²)。
desc.en: Taking x and y as an arrow’s two parts, the arrow’s length √(x² + y²).

desc.zh: 把 x、y 当成箭头的横竖两个分量，给出箭头指的方向，以周为单位：往右 0，往下 1/4，往上 −1/4。
desc.en: Taking x and y as an arrow’s two parts, the way it points, in turns: right 0, down 1/4, up −1/4.

desc.zh: a 小于 b 的格子给 1，其余给 0。
desc.en: 1 where a is less than b, else 0.
